description: This bar chart, titled "Factual Errors," displays the number of factual errors made by three different question answering (QA) systems—NoR QA (yellow with grid pattern), OneR QA (red with dot pattern), and IRCt QA (blue with diagonal stripes)—across four distinct datasets: HotpotQA, 2WikiMQA, MuSiQue, and IIRC. The horizontal axis lists the datasets in left-to-right order, while the vertical axis represents the count of factual errors, scaled linearly from 0 to 35 with tick marks at intervals of 5. Each dataset has three adjacent bars, one for each QA system, showing the specific error count for that system on that dataset. For HotpotQA, the values are 15 for NoR QA, 10 for OneR QA, and 5 for IRCt QA. For 2WikiMQA, the values are 29 for NoR QA, 23 for OneR QA, and 14 for IRCt QA. For MuSiQue, the values are 28 for NoR QA, 27 for OneR QA, and 23 for IRCt QA. For IIRC, the values are 15 for NoR QA, 14 for OneR QA, and 11 for IRCt QA. The bars are not sorted by height and are presented in the order of the datasets listed on the x-axis. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their standard color and pattern coding.
